_comment: Source of truth for the positions page. Hand-edited when a position is opened or closed; build.py adds the live price and derives R. The thesis is written AT ENTRY - a thesis composed at exit is marking your own homework, and the whole point of the page is that the claim was on the record before the outcome was.
_symbol_note: Yahoo symbols. Japan 225 uses NIY=F, the yen Nikkei future, NOT ^N225: the spot index closes with Tokyo while CMC's cash CFD tracks the future, so ^N225 reads about 0.8% away from the platform and puts the stop distance visibly wrong.
_r_note: 1R is the distance from entry to the initial stop. Every outcome on this page is quoted in multiples of it, so positions of different sizes are comparable.

open.name: GBP/CHF
open.thesis: The SNB caps the franc: rates at zero, and it sells francs when the currency runs. That is what protects the 3.75% sterling pays.
open.catalyst: The MPC meets on 17 September. The market expects a rise, widening the gap this earns.
open.breaks: The Bank of England starts cutting, or the SNB stops selling francs into a rally.

open.name: Japan 225
open.thesis: AI chips are built and tested on Advantest and Tokyo Electron equipment. Price weighting makes the Nikkei the most concentrated way to own both.
open.catalyst: The index had fallen 16% from its June high, then rose 2% on chip stocks in the session before this went on.
open.breaks: Semiconductor capex slows and the two chip names fall. Nothing else in the index is big enough to offset them.
open.postmortem: The thesis needed six months. The stop and target were four days apart.

open.name: USD/MXN
open.thesis: Nearshoring keeps pulling investment into Mexico while Banxico holds real rates high. Both push the peso up against the dollar.
open.catalyst: The peso set fresh twelve-month highs twice in the three sessions before entry.
open.breaks: The USMCA review goes against Mexico, and the nearshoring case with it.

_thesis_note: thesis: why the PRICE moves this way, or why the carry is not handed back in the exchange rate. Describing the carry is not a thesis. Caps: thesis 24 words, catalyst 22, breaks 20. See the position-thesis skill.
_dp_note: dp is DISPLAY precision only. The stored entry and stop keep their full precision, so R and the distance to the stop are unaffected by it.
_ccy_note: ccy is what the PRICE is quoted in: for a cross that is the quote currency (the second one), for an index the currency of the index.
_sources_note: As at 10/09/2026. Policy rates on Bloomberg: UKBRBASE 3.75, SZLTDEP 0.00, MXONBR 6.50, FDTR 3.75. Advantest over the 10% cap at the 31/07 review, weight cut from 01/10 (Nikkei Inc). Mexican FDI and the 2026 USMCA joint review from press coverage, not a primary source - re-check before quoting.
